page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.6xlarge is a storage-focused virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs from the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor family, running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, offering 70,866 GB of bundled HDD storage. This high-density local storage configuration is paired with an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The server does not include any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the massive local HDD capacity and dedicated compute resources, the ecs.d1.6xlarge is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring high-density, cold or sequential storage. It is highly suited for large-scale data warehousing, distributed file systems like HDFS, log processing, and big data analytics where massive storage volume is prioritized over high-speed SSD IOPS.
